messages:
Tess (PM): Starting a compact spec convo: goal = make private deployment upgrades predictable for netops and field. Key idea: compatibility tiers + an "upgrade stamp" that summarizes planned network effects. Tiers: 0 (no-host-change), 1 (neighbors/iptables), 2 (peering/route edits).

Connor (eng): Implementation notes: installer emits an upgrade_stamp.json with fields: tier, host_edits[], required_ports[], audit_token. Dry-run prints the stamp + sha256 of signed bundle. Example CLI:
```
installer --stamp --dry-run
# outputs: { tier:1, host_edits:["add-route"], ports:[443,179], audit_token: "tok-xyz" }
```
This stamp drives UI gating and audit logs.

Yara (field): Field requests: 1) a printable preflight report to hand to customers; 2) an "audit token" customers can store in their ticketing systems to confirm approval; 3) a safety-net 'relay' we can enable for early installs to avoid touching their NAT.

Omar (netops): Netops: require deterministic egress for tiers 1/2. If preserve-egress fails, preflight must return FAIL and suggest options: enable-relay, schedule-maintenance, or manual-peering. Also need explicit list of firewall rules per vendor (AWS SG, Azure NSG, Palo Alto).

Connor (eng): We'll add a preflight scorer that returns PASS/WARN/FAIL and a short reasons list. Score rules: FAIL if tier>0 and BGP not established, WARN if ephemeral egress detected, PASS if egress preserved and required ports reachable. We'll persist reports to asset-store/<org>/<install>/preflight-<ts>.json and expose a signed URL.

release-bot: release-bot: nightly preflight-check queued for pilot-3 at 02:30 UTC

Tess (PM): Suggested launch criteria:
- Preflight PASS on 3 pilot customers covering on-prem edge, VPC with managed NAT, and hybrid.
- Signed-bundle verification working for airgap customers (field-run).
- Safety-net relay exercised in 2 pilots.
- Rollback < 15m for 90% of operator upgrades in canary cohort.
If satisfied, bump to GA.

Yara (field): Action items: I'll collect pilot nominations and test the relay flow. Need a one-pager showing stamp examples and what each tier implies for customer comms.

Omar (netops): I'll compile firewall + BGP checklist and a template sign-off note (ASN, neighbor IPs, expected egress). Will also review audit_token format to ensure it ties to our audit logs.

Connor (eng): Action items: 
- implement upgrade_stamp + dry-run output (ETA 1w)
- add preflight scorer & persist reports (ETA 2w)
- surface signed-bundle sha in CLI (ETA 1w)
I'll also add metric: "preflight_pass_rate" and alert if < 85% for pilots.

Tess (PM): Great. I'll draft the WIP in /docs/private/upgrade-stamp.md and coordinate with security for audit tooling. Keep conservative defaults: default tier=0 (no network edits) unless customer opts in. Ping me with pilot names.
